mode.description: Release topology: hub, cluster (one workload cluster) or combined (single cluster).

clusters.description: Workload clusters joined with mode=cluster; the hub-api issues each one's join Secret <name>-join-<name>.

remote.description: Addresses joined clusters dial: TCP passthrough to the hub Services; connectors verify the in-cluster names.

capacity.description: The hub chart's `capacity` values (ADR-335 D2, D8; REQ-CAP-004). Every field is optional; defaults derive from the evidence store and the cluster. Changes apply on helm upgrade. Ring, frozen, spool, upload and ongoing-source limits are node collector values (ADR-246).

evidenceStorage.description: Usable evidence bytes after the backend full threshold and replication overhead. Default: the bundled object store's volume size; required for an external store.

storageAssurance.description: qualifiedReservedBackend requires dedicated or backend-enforced capacity; only it satisfies the isolation claim.

capturesPerCluster.description: Concurrent captures per cluster. Default max(8, node count).

namespaceLimit.description: Maximum stored bytes per namespace, so many small workloads cannot monopolize enrollment. Omitted: no namespace cap.

share.description: Protected allocation per workload. Default usable capacity ÷ max(eligible workloads, 8).

limit.description: Hard maximum per workload (protected share plus burst). Default 10%.

region.description: Regional connector for mode=cluster or mode=combined.

joinSecret.description: mode=cluster: the hub's join Secret <name>-join-<cluster>, copied into this release's namespace.

bootstrapSecret.description: mode=combined: existing Secret with bootstrap.json; default <name>-region-bootstrap.

collector.description: ADR-246: the asservat node collector DaemonSet (off by default; disposable-host guard).

namespace.description: The collector namespace, the only one with the privileged Pod Security exception; never kube-*, default, the release or connector namespace.

live.description: Optional existing node live-processing ceilings. Null disables live projections; hub delivery.liveRead independently authorizes viewers.

service.description: The S3 Service; NodePort or LoadBalancer when joined clusters write evidence (remote.objectStore).

processingOperators.description: Explicit opt-in to an initially empty dedicated privacy processing group; never ordinary-users authority.

installerEvidenceStore.description: Bundled storage derives these public coordinates and roots. External storage requires all four fields.

oneOf.description: Percentage of the usable evidence storage.
